exercises.name: Neck rolls
exercises.cue: Slow circles: ear toward shoulder, chin toward chest. Shoulders stay relaxed.
steps: Sit or stand tall with relaxed shoulders.
Drop your chin, then roll one ear toward your shoulder.
Continue slowly around; switch direction halfway.

exercises.name: Chin tucks
exercises.cue: Glide your chin straight back into a double chin, pause, then release.
steps: Sit tall and look straight ahead.
Draw your chin straight back without tilting your head.
Hold for a breath, release, repeat.

exercises.name: Neck side stretch
exercises.cue: Ear toward shoulder, opposite shoulder reaching down.
steps: Sit tall and let one ear drop toward the shoulder.
Reach the opposite hand toward the floor.
Optionally rest the same-side hand lightly on your head.

exercises.name: Levator scapulae stretch
exercises.cue: Nose toward armpit, gentle hand assist.
steps: Turn your head about 45° to one side.
Drop your nose toward that armpit.
Use the same-side hand to add gentle pressure.

exercises.name: Shoulder circles
exercises.cue: Straight arm, draw the biggest slow circle you can without twisting your body.
steps: Stand tall and brace your core.
Reach one straight arm forward and up.
Draw a slow, large circle behind you and back to the start.

exercises.name: Arm circles
exercises.cue: Arms out wide, small circles growing bigger. Reverse halfway.
steps: Hold both arms out to the sides.
Make small circles, gradually getting bigger.
Reverse direction halfway through.

exercises.name: Wall slides
exercises.cue: Back and forearms on the wall, slide your arms up into a Y and back down.
steps: Stand with your back, head and forearms against a wall.
Slide your arms up into a Y, keeping contact.
Lower slowly back to a W shape.

exercises.name: Thread the needle
exercises.cue: On all fours, slide one arm under your body and rest that shoulder on the floor.
steps: Start on hands and knees.
Slide one arm under your chest, palm up.
Lower that shoulder and temple to the floor and breathe.

exercises.name: Doorway chest stretch
exercises.cue: Forearms on the door frame, step through gently.
steps: Place forearms on a door frame, elbows at shoulder height.
Step one foot through the doorway.
Lean forward until you feel the chest open.

exercises.name: Cross-body shoulder stretch
exercises.cue: Pull a straight arm across your chest, shoulder down.
steps: Bring one straight arm across your chest.
Hold it above the elbow with your other hand.
Keep the shoulder down and away from your ear.

exercises.name: Band pull-aparts
exercises.cue: Arms straight, pull the band to your chest, squeeze the shoulder blades.
steps: Hold a band at shoulder height, arms straight.
Pull the band apart until it touches your chest.
Return slowly with control.

exercises.name: Open book
exercises.cue: Lie on your side, knees bent. Sweep the top arm open and follow it with your eyes.
steps: Lie on your side with knees bent to 90° and arms stacked.
Sweep the top arm up and over to the other side.
Follow your hand with your eyes, then return.

exercises.name: Foam roller extension
exercises.cue: Roller under your upper back, hands behind head, arch over it.
steps: Lie with a foam roller across your upper back.
Support your head with your hands, hips on the floor.
Gently arch back over the roller; move it up a few inches and repeat.

exercises.name: Puppy pose
exercises.cue: Hips over knees, arms long, chest melts toward the floor.
steps: Start on hands and knees.
Walk your hands forward, keeping hips over knees.
Let your chest sink toward the floor.

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.cue: On all fours, round your back up, then let your belly drop and look up. Move with your breath.
steps: Start on hands and knees.
Exhale and round your back toward the ceiling.
Inhale, drop your belly and lift your gaze.

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.cue: Knees wide, hips back toward your heels, arms long. Breathe into your back.
steps: Kneel with big toes together and knees wide.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Reach your arms forward and rest your forehead down.

exercises.name: Seated twist
exercises.cue: Sit tall and rotate from your mid-back, one hand behind you for support.
steps: Sit tall, cross one leg over the other.
Rotate toward the top knee from your mid-back.
Use your hand behind you to stay tall.

exercises.name: Cobra
exercises.cue: Hands under shoulders, press up gently, hips stay down.
steps: Lie face down with hands under your shoulders.
Press up slowly, keeping your hips on the floor.
Relax your glutes and breathe.

exercises.name: Supine twist
exercises.cue: Knees drop to one side, shoulders stay down.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Let both knees fall to one side.
Keep both shoulders on the floor and look the other way.

exercises.name: Jefferson curl
exercises.cue: Roll down one vertebra at a time, very light weight, roll back up slowly.
steps: Stand tall holding a very light weight.
Tuck your chin and roll down one vertebra at a time.
Pause at the bottom, then roll back up slowly.

exercises.name: 90/90 switches
exercises.cue: Seated with both knees bent at 90°. Rotate your knees side to side while staying tall.
steps: Sit with both knees bent at 90°, one in front, one to the side.
Stay tall and rotate both knees to the other side.
Keep switching slowly.

exercises.name: Kneeling hip flexor
exercises.cue: Half-kneeling, squeeze the back glute and gently shift your hips forward.
steps: Kneel on one knee, other foot in front.
Squeeze the glute of the back leg.
Shift your hips forward until you feel a stretch.

exercises.name: Pigeon
exercises.cue: Front shin across the mat, back leg long. Fold forward if it feels good.
steps: From all fours, bring one knee forward behind your wrist.
Extend the other leg long behind you.
Square your hips and fold forward if comfortable.

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.cue: Sink into a deep squat, heels down, elbows nudging knees out. Hold onto something if needed.
steps: Stand with feet a bit wider than hips.
Sink as low as you can with heels down.
Press your knees out with your elbows.

exercises.name: Frog stretch
exercises.cue: Knees wide on the floor, ankles in line with knees. Gently rock your hips back.
steps: Start on all fours and slide your knees wide.
Keep ankles in line with knees.
Rock your hips back slowly.

exercises.name: Hip circles
exercises.cue: On all fours, draw the biggest slow circle you can with your knee.
steps: Start on hands and knees.
Lift one knee and draw a big slow circle.
Reverse direction halfway.

exercises.name: Butterfly
exercises.cue: Soles together, knees fall open, sit tall.
steps: Sit with soles of your feet together.
Let your knees fall open.
Sit tall and hinge forward slightly.

exercises.name: Figure four
exercises.cue: On your back, ankle over knee, pull the leg toward you.
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Pull the bottom thigh toward your chest.

exercises.name: Cossack squat
exercises.cue: Wide stance, shift into one leg, other leg straight with toes up.
steps: Take a wide stance.
Shift down into one leg, keeping the other straight.
Move side to side slowly.

exercises.name: Couch stretch
exercises.cue: Back knee at the wall, shin up the wall, squeeze the glute.
steps: Kneel with your back shin up against a wall or couch.
Bring the other foot forward into a lunge.
Lift your chest and squeeze the back glute.

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.cue: Step into a lunge, drop the inside elbow toward your foot, then rotate and reach up.
steps: Step into a long lunge.
Drop the inside elbow toward the front foot.
Rotate and reach that arm to the ceiling.

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.cue: Heel forward, leg straight, hinge at the hips with a flat back.
steps: Place one heel forward, leg straight.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Keep the standing knee soft.

exercises.name: Standing forward fold
exercises.cue: Bend over, soft knees, let your head and arms hang.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward and let your upper body hang.
Keep knees soft and sway gently.

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.cue: Heel to glute, knees together, hips forward.
steps: Stand tall and hold onto something for balance.
Pull one heel toward your glute.
Keep knees together and tuck your hips slightly.

exercises.name: Pancake
exercises.cue: Legs wide, hinge forward from the hips with a long spine.
steps: Sit with legs wide and toes up.
Hinge forward from the hips.
Walk your hands forward with a long spine.

exercises.name: Calf stretch
exercises.cue: Hands on a wall, back leg straight, heel pressed into the floor.
steps: Place your hands on a wall.
Step one leg back, straight, heel down.
Lean forward until the calf stretches.

exercises.name: Ankle rocks
exercises.cue: Half-kneeling, drive your front knee out over your toes while the heel stays down.
steps: Half-kneel with one foot forward.
Drive the front knee forward over your toes.
Keep the heel down; rock back and forth.

exercises.name: Ankle circles
exercises.cue: Lift a foot and draw slow circles in both directions.
steps: Sit or stand on one leg.
Draw slow circles with your foot.
Switch direction halfway.

exercises.name: Toe squat
exercises.cue: Kneel with toes tucked under, sit back onto your heels.
steps: Kneel with toes tucked under.
Sit back onto your heels.
Breathe; lean forward to ease off.

exercises.name: Wrist circles
exercises.cue: Interlace your fingers and roll your wrists in both directions.
steps: Interlace your fingers.
Roll your wrists in big circles.
Switch direction halfway.

exercises.name: Wrist rocks
exercises.cue: On all fours, fingers forward, gently rock forward and back over your hands.
steps: Start on all fours, fingers forward.
Rock forward over your hands.
Rock back; repeat slowly.

exercises.name: Prayer stretch
exercises.cue: Palms together, lower your hands while keeping palms pressed.
steps: Press your palms together in front of your chest.
Slowly lower your hands, keeping palms together.
Hold where you feel the stretch.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Switch (No Hands)
exercises.cue: Switch knees side to side without using your hands for support.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Switch Extension
exercises.cue: Switch sides, then lift up onto the back knee and squeeze the glute.

exercises.name: Adductor Dips
exercises.cue: One leg out to the side, rock your hips back and forth into the inner thigh.

exercises.name: Adductor Rocks
exercises.cue: On all fours with one leg out wide, rock your hips back toward your heel.

exercises.name: Air Squats
exercises.cue: Feet shoulder-width, sit back and down, chest up, stand tall.

exercises.name: Airplane
exercises.cue: Hinge on one leg, arms out wide, rotate your hips open and closed.

exercises.name: Aquaman
exercises.cue: Face down, lift the opposite arm and leg, switch with control.

exercises.name: Arm Swings
exercises.cue: Swing your arms across your chest and open wide, loose and easy.

exercises.name: Baby Cobra
exercises.cue: Face down, lift just your chest a few inches using your back, hands light.

exercises.name: Back Leg Raise
exercises.cue: Stand tall, hold something, lift one straight leg back and squeeze the glute.

exercises.name: Bear Hug
exercises.cue: Wrap your arms around yourself and round your upper back.

exercises.name: Bent Arm Pike
exercises.cue: Forearms down, hips high, press your chest toward your knees.

exercises.name: Bent Over Calf
exercises.cue: Hinge forward, lift the front toes, and lean over the straight leg.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch Hold
exercises.cue: Opposite elbow toward knee, other leg long, hold the twist.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.cue: On all fours, reach the opposite arm and leg long and hold.

exercises.name: Bird Dog Plank
exercises.cue: From a high plank, lift the opposite arm and leg and hold.

exercises.name: Bird Dogs
exercises.cue: On all fours, alternate reaching opposite arm and leg, slow and steady.

exercises.name: Bow Pose
exercises.cue: Face down, hold your ankles and kick into your hands to lift your chest.

exercises.name: Bridge
exercises.cue: On your back, feet flat, lift your hips and squeeze your glutes.

exercises.name: Bridge Leg Lift
exercises.cue: Hold a bridge and lift one leg straight, hips level.

exercises.name: Bulldog
exercises.cue: On all fours, lift your knees an inch off the floor and hold.

exercises.name: Butt Kicks
exercises.cue: Jog in place, kicking your heels toward your glutes.

exercises.name: Cactus Arms (Seated)
exercises.cue: Seated, arms in a cactus shape, squeeze your shoulder blades back.

exercises.name: Cactus Arms
exercises.cue: Arms bent at 90° out to the sides, open the chest and squeeze back.

exercises.name: Calf Raises
exercises.cue: Rise up onto your toes, pause, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Camel Pose
exercises.cue: Kneeling, hands on your lower back or heels, lift your chest and open the front.

exercises.name: Chair Pose
exercises.cue: Sit back as if into a chair, arms overhead, weight in your heels.

exercises.name: Chest Opener
exercises.cue: Hands behind your head, open your elbows wide and lift your chest.

exercises.name: Chest Opener (Hands Clasped)
exercises.cue: Clasp your hands behind you, straighten your arms and lift the chest.

exercises.name: Controlled Butt Kicks
exercises.cue: Slowly pull one heel toward your glute and lower with control.

exercises.name: Corner Pecs
exercises.cue: Forearms on two walls of a corner, lean in to open the chest.

exercises.name: Cow Face
exercises.cue: One hand reaches down your back from above, the other from below; try to meet.

exercises.name: Cross Leg Fold
exercises.cue: Cross one foot over the other and fold forward.

exercises.name: Cross Leg Side Bend
exercises.cue: Cross your legs, reach one arm overhead and lean to the side.

exercises.name: Crunch Hold
exercises.cue: Curl your shoulders off the floor and hold, lower back down.

exercises.name: Crunches
exercises.cue: On your back, curl up toward your knees and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Curtsy Lunge Hold
exercises.cue: Step one leg behind and across, sink down and hold.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.cue: On your back, arms and knees up; extend opposite arm and leg and hold.

exercises.name: Dead Bugs
exercises.cue: Alternate extending opposite arm and leg, lower back pressed down.

exercises.name: Dead Hang
exercises.cue: Hang from a bar with relaxed shoulders, let your body lengthen.

exercises.name: Deep Split Squat
exercises.cue: Long split stance, sink the back knee low and hold.

exercises.name: Dip Hold
exercises.cue: Hands on a bench behind you, lower and hold with chest open.

exercises.name: Diver (Seated)
exercises.cue: Seated, reach your arms forward and long, rounding through the back.

exercises.name: Diver
exercises.cue: Seated with legs long, reach your arms forward over your legs.

exercises.name: Double Knee Spinal Twist
exercises.cue: On your back, drop both knees to one side, arms wide.

exercises.name: Double Pigeon
exercises.cue: Stack your shins on top of each other, sit tall or fold forward.

exercises.name: Down Dog Split
exercises.cue: From downward dog, lift one leg high behind you.

exercises.name: Downward Dog
exercises.cue: Hands and feet down, hips high, press your chest toward your thighs.

exercises.name: Dynamic Chest Flys
exercises.cue: Swing your arms open wide and back together across your chest.

exercises.name: Dynamic Quad Stretch
exercises.cue: Alternate pulling each heel to your glute for a moment.

exercises.name: Dynamic Side Bends
exercises.cue: Reach one arm overhead and bend side to side, alternating.

exercises.name: Dynamic Wide Leg Forward Fold
exercises.cue: Wide stance, fold down and come back up slowly, repeating.

exercises.name: Eagle Arm
exercises.cue: Wrap one arm under the other, palms together, lift the elbows.

exercises.name: Elbow Pike
exercises.cue: From a forearm plank, push your hips up high and lower back down.

exercises.name: Elbow Plank
exercises.cue: On your forearms, body in a straight line, brace your core.

exercises.name: Elbow Plank Leg Lift
exercises.cue: In a forearm plank, lift one straight leg and hold.

exercises.name: Elbow Side Plank
exercises.cue: On one forearm, stack your feet and lift your hips.

exercises.name: Elbow Side Plank Leg Lift
exercises.cue: In a side plank, lift the top leg and hold.

exercises.name: Figure Four Twist
exercises.cue: On your back in figure four, drop both legs to one side.

exercises.name: Flutter Kicks
exercises.cue: On your back, legs low, kick small and fast up and down.

exercises.name: Folded Butterfly
exercises.cue: Butterfly position, fold forward over your feet.

exercises.name: Forearm Stretch
exercises.cue: Arm straight, pull your fingers back gently with the other hand.

exercises.name: Front Leg Raise
exercises.cue: Stand tall and lift one straight leg in front of you.

exercises.name: Front Split
exercises.cue: Slide into a split with one leg forward, support with blocks if needed.

exercises.name: Gate Opener
exercises.cue: Lift your knee up, open it out to the side and set the foot down.

exercises.name: Good Mornings
exercises.cue: Hands behind head, hinge at the hips with a flat back, stand up.

exercises.name: Half Bow
exercises.cue: Face down, hold one ankle and kick into your hand to lift.

exercises.name: Half Moon
exercises.cue: Balance on one leg, body sideways, top arm and leg reaching long.

exercises.name: Half Wheel
exercises.cue: Bridge up and clasp your hands under you, lift the chest.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Hinge
exercises.cue: Half kneeling, hinge your hips back over the front leg.

exercises.name: Hamstring Pulls
exercises.cue: On your back, hold behind one thigh and straighten the leg up.

exercises.name: Hamstring Scoops
exercises.cue: Step a heel forward, scoop your arms down and up as you hinge.

exercises.name: Hand Plank
exercises.cue: High plank on your hands, body straight, core tight.

exercises.name: Hand Plank Leg Lift
exercises.cue: In a high plank, lift one leg and hold.

exercises.name: Hand Side Plank
exercises.cue: On one hand, feet stacked, hips lifted, other arm up.

exercises.name: Hand Side Plank Leg Lift
exercises.cue: In a side plank on your hand, lift the top leg.

exercises.name: Happy Baby
exercises.cue: On your back, hold the outsides of your feet, knees toward armpits.

exercises.name: Heel-to-Toe Rocks
exercises.cue: Rock from your heels up onto your toes and back.

exercises.name: High Knee Twists
exercises.cue: Lift each knee and twist the opposite elbow toward it.

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.cue: Run in place, driving your knees up high.

exercises.name: Hip Bridges
exercises.cue: Lift and lower your hips from the floor, squeezing at the top.

exercises.name: Hollow Body
exercises.cue: On your back, arms and legs long and lifted, lower back pressed down.

exercises.name: Humble Warrior
exercises.cue: Warrior stance, hands clasped behind, fold inside the front knee.

exercises.name: Hurdler
exercises.cue: Seated, one leg straight, other foot in; fold over the straight leg.

exercises.name: Jump Squats
exercises.cue: Squat down then jump up, land softly.

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
exercises.cue: Jump feet out while arms go up, then back together.

exercises.name: Kang Squat
exercises.cue: Hinge forward with a flat back, then sit into a squat and come back.

exercises.name: Knee Circles
exercises.cue: Hands on knees, circle them gently both directions.

exercises.name: Knee Push-Ups
exercises.cue: Push-ups from your knees, body straight from knees to head.

exercises.name: Kneeling Hip Circles
exercises.cue: Kneeling, draw big slow circles with your hips.

exercises.name: Kneeling Hip Hinge
exercises.cue: Kneeling tall, sit your hips back toward heels and drive them forward.

exercises.name: Kneeling Quad
exercises.cue: Half kneeling, reach back for the back foot and pull it toward you.

exercises.name: Kneeling Scapular Push-Ups
exercises.cue: On knees and hands, arms straight, squeeze and spread your shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Kneeling Wrist Extension Circles
exercises.cue: On all fours, fingers back toward knees, circle your weight gently.

exercises.name: Knees Hugs
exercises.cue: Standing, hug one knee to your chest at a time, alternating.

exercises.name: Knees-to-Chest
exercises.cue: On your back, hug both knees to your chest and rock gently.

exercises.name: Lateral Foot Rocks
exercises.cue: Rock onto the outsides of your feet and back.

exercises.name: Lateral Leg Swing
exercises.cue: Hold something and swing one leg side to side across your body.

exercises.name: Lateral Lunge
exercises.cue: Step wide, sit into one hip, other leg straight.

exercises.name: Leaning 90/90
exercises.cue: In 90/90, lean your chest forward over the front shin.

exercises.name: Leaning Figure Four
exercises.cue: Standing, ankle over opposite knee, sit back as if into a chair.

exercises.name: Leg Lift
exercises.cue: On your back, lift one straight leg up and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Leg Raises
exercises.cue: On your back, lift both legs to vertical and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Leg Swings
exercises.cue: Hold something and swing one leg forward and back.

exercises.name: Legs-Up-Wall
exercises.cue: Lie down with your legs resting up the wall. Relax.

exercises.name: Lizard Pose
exercises.cue: Low lunge, both hands inside the front foot, sink the hips.

exercises.name: Locust Pose
exercises.cue: Face down, lift your chest, arms and legs off the floor.

exercises.name: Lunge
exercises.cue: Step into a lunge, back knee low, reach your arms up.

exercises.name: Lying Ankle Circles
exercises.cue: On your back, lift one leg and circle the ankle.

exercises.name: Lying Hamstring
exercises.cue: On your back, lift one straight leg and hold behind it.

exercises.name: Lying Quad Stretch
exercises.cue: On your side, pull the top heel toward your glute.

exercises.name: Lying Side Leg Raise
exercises.cue: On your side, lift the top leg up and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Modified Reverse Prayer
exercises.cue: Hold opposite elbows behind your back and lift your chest.

exercises.name: Modified Seated Twist
exercises.cue: Seated with legs crossed, twist gently with a hand on the knee.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.cue: High plank, drive your knees toward your chest, alternating.

exercises.name: Narrow Push Up Hold
exercises.cue: Hands close, lower halfway with elbows in and hold.

exercises.name: Narrow Squat Hold
exercises.cue: Feet together, sit low and hold, arms forward.

exercises.name: Neck Extension
exercises.cue: Slowly tip your head back to look up, then return.

exercises.name: Neck Flex
exercises.cue: Drop your chin to your chest and let the neck lengthen.

exercises.name: Neck Flexion
exercises.cue: Hands behind your head, gently draw your chin to your chest.

exercises.name: Neck Laterals (Seated)
exercises.cue: Seated, tilt your ear toward your shoulder, hand gently assisting.

exercises.name: Neck Laterals
exercises.cue: Tilt your ear toward your shoulder, opposite shoulder down.

exercises.name: Neck Rotation
exercises.cue: Turn your head slowly to look over each shoulder.

exercises.name: One Arm Hug (Seated)
exercises.cue: Seated, pull one arm across your chest.

exercises.name: One Arm Hug
exercises.cue: Pull one straight arm across your chest with the other arm.

exercises.name: Overhead Reach
exercises.cue: Interlace your fingers and reach up tall.

exercises.name: Overhead Tricep (Seated)
exercises.cue: Seated, bend one arm behind your head and press the elbow gently.

exercises.name: Overhead Tricep
exercises.cue: Bend one arm behind your head and press the elbow back gently.

exercises.name: Peaceful Warrior
exercises.cue: From warrior II, reach the front arm up and back, back hand slides down the leg.

exercises.name: Pelvic Tilt Press
exercises.cue: On your back, press your lower back into the floor and release.

exercises.name: Pike
exercises.cue: Hands and feet on the floor, hips high, legs straight.

exercises.name: Pistol Squat Hold
exercises.cue: Squat low on one leg, other leg straight in front; hold.

exercises.name: Plow
exercises.cue: From your back, lift your legs over your head toward the floor.

exercises.name: Push Up Hold
exercises.cue: Lower halfway into a push-up and hold.

exercises.name: Push-Ups
exercises.cue: Body straight, lower your chest to the floor and press up.

exercises.name: Rag Doll
exercises.cue: Fold forward, hold opposite elbows and let your upper body hang.

exercises.name: Reclined Butterfly
exercises.cue: On your back, soles together, knees falling open.

exercises.name: Reverse Butterfly
exercises.cue: Lying face down, knees wide and soles together, let the hips sink.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.cue: Step back into a lunge and return, alternating legs.

exercises.name: Reverse Plank
exercises.cue: Seated, hands behind, lift your hips so your body is straight.

exercises.name: Reverse Plank Leg Lift
exercises.cue: In a reverse plank, lift one straight leg.

exercises.name: Reverse Prayer Pose
exercises.cue: Palms together behind your back, fingers pointing up.

exercises.name: Reverse Shoulder
exercises.cue: Clasp hands behind your back and lift them away from you.

exercises.name: Reverse Table Top
exercises.cue: Hands and feet down, belly up, lift your hips level with knees.

exercises.name: Revolved Wide Leg Forward Fold
exercises.cue: Wide fold, one hand down, other arm reaching up as you twist.

exercises.name: Run in Place
exercises.cue: Light jog on the spot.

exercises.name: Runner's Lunge Twist
exercises.cue: Low lunge, back knee down, twist toward the front leg and reach up.

exercises.name: Saddle Pose
exercises.cue: Kneel with feet beside hips and lean back as far as comfortable.

exercises.name: Scalene Stretch
exercises.cue: Hand on your collarbone, tilt and lift your chin away.

exercises.name: Scapula Stretch
exercises.cue: Hand on the back of your head, tuck your chin and pull gently.

exercises.name: Scorpion
exercises.cue: Face down, sweep one leg up and across your body behind you.

exercises.name: Seated Chest
exercises.cue: Seated, hands behind you, lift your chest and squeeze back.

exercises.name: Seated Figure Four
exercises.cue: Seated, ankle on opposite knee, lean forward with a flat back.

exercises.name: Seated Fold
exercises.cue: Legs long, fold forward over them.

exercises.name: Seated Hamstring
exercises.cue: Seated at the edge, one leg straight, hinge forward.

exercises.name: Seated Knee Drops
exercises.cue: Seated, feet wide, drop both knees side to side.

exercises.name: Seated Straddle
exercises.cue: Seated with legs wide, sit tall and walk your hands forward.

exercises.name: Shoulder Cross
exercises.cue: Face down, one arm across under your chest, roll onto it.

exercises.name: Shoulder Opener
exercises.cue: Face down, one arm out to the side, roll your body away from it.

exercises.name: Shoulder Rolls (Seated)
exercises.cue: Seated, roll your shoulders up, back and down.

exercises.name: Shoulder Rolls
exercises.cue: Roll your shoulders up, back and down in big circles.

exercises.name: Shoulder Stand
exercises.cue: Lift your legs and hips up, supporting your back with your hands.

exercises.name: Side Bend
exercises.cue: Reach one arm overhead and lean to the side.

exercises.name: Single Leg Shin Stretch
exercises.cue: Kneel on one shin with the top of the foot down, lean back gently.

exercises.name: Single Leg Stand
exercises.cue: Balance on one leg, standing tall.

exercises.name: Sit-Ups
exercises.cue: From lying, curl all the way up and lower down with control.

exercises.name: Soleus Stretch
exercises.cue: Hands on a wall, both knees bent, back heel down.

exercises.name: Spiderman Push Up Hold
exercises.cue: Lower into a push-up and bring one knee toward the elbow; hold.

exercises.name: Spinal Twist
exercises.cue: On your back, cross one knee over your body, arm out wide.

exercises.name: Split Lunge Hold
exercises.cue: Hold a split squat with the back knee just off the floor.

exercises.name: Split Squat Twists
exercises.cue: In a split squat, twist your torso toward the front leg.

exercises.name: Split Squats
exercises.cue: Split stance, lower and lift without moving your feet.

exercises.name: Squat Hold
exercises.cue: Squat to parallel and hold, chest up.

exercises.name: Squat Stretch
exercises.cue: Deep squat, hands together, elbows pushing knees out.

exercises.name: Standing Frog
exercises.cue: Wide squat with toes out, hands on knees, press them open.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Openers
exercises.cue: Lift a knee and circle it out to the side and down.

exercises.name: Standing Lunge Twist
exercises.cue: In a lunge, twist toward the front leg with arms open.

exercises.name: Standing Quad
exercises.cue: Stand on one leg and pull the other heel to your glute.

exercises.name: Sumo Squat Hold
exercises.cue: Wide stance, toes out, sit low and hold.

exercises.name: Sumo Squat Twists
exercises.cue: In a wide squat, drop one shoulder toward the opposite knee, alternate.

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.cue: Face down, lift your arms and legs off the floor and hold.

exercises.name: Thunderbolt
exercises.cue: Kneel and sit back on your heels, tops of feet down.

exercises.name: Toe Raises
exercises.cue: Back to the wall, lift your toes off the floor and lower.

exercises.name: Toe Stretch
exercises.cue: Kneeling, pull the toes of one foot back gently.

exercises.name: Toe Touch
exercises.cue: Fold forward and reach for your toes, knees soft.

exercises.name: Toe Touch Hold
exercises.cue: On your back, legs up, reach for your toes and hold.

exercises.name: Toe Touch Twist
exercises.cue: Wide stance, reach one hand to the opposite foot, alternate.

exercises.name: Toe-to-Wall
exercises.cue: Toes up on the wall, heel down, lean in.

exercises.name: Towel Calf Stretch
exercises.cue: Seated, loop a towel around your foot and pull the toes back.

exercises.name: Tree Pose
exercises.cue: Stand on one leg, other foot on your inner leg, hands up.

exercises.name: Triangle Pose
exercises.cue: Wide stance, reach forward then tip down, top arm to the ceiling.

exercises.name: Trunk Rotation
exercises.cue: Seated, rotate your upper body side to side.

exercises.name: Trunk Twist
exercises.cue: Arms out, rotate your torso side to side.

exercises.name: Twisted Sphinx
exercises.cue: On forearms face down, bend one knee and drop it across.

exercises.name: Upward Dog
exercises.cue: Face down, press up through straight arms, thighs lifted.

exercises.name: Upward Frog
exercises.cue: Frog position with the chest lifted up on your hands.

exercises.name: Upward Salute
exercises.cue: Reach your arms overhead and gently lean back.

exercises.name: V-Sit
exercises.cue: Balance on your sit bones with legs and arms lifted in a V.

exercises.name: Wall Arms
exercises.cue: Back to the wall, raise your arms up and down along it.

exercises.name: Wall Dog
exercises.cue: Hands on the wall, walk back and hinge until your back is flat.

exercises.name: Wall Handstand
exercises.cue: Kick up or walk your feet up the wall into a handstand.

exercises.name: Wall Pecs
exercises.cue: Arm on the wall behind you, turn away to open the chest.

exercises.name: Wall Pike
exercises.cue: Hands down, walk your feet up the wall into a pike.

exercises.name: Wall Plank
exercises.cue: Lean into the wall on your forearms, body straight.

exercises.name: Wall Sit
exercises.cue: Back on the wall, sit until thighs are parallel and hold.

exercises.name: Warrior I
exercises.cue: Lunge with the back foot angled, arms reaching up.

exercises.name: Warrior II
exercises.cue: Wide stance, front knee bent, arms long side to side.

exercises.name: Warrior III
exercises.cue: Balance on one leg, body and back leg parallel to the floor.

exercises.name: Wheel Pose
exercises.cue: From your back, press up on hands and feet into a full backbend.

exercises.name: Wide Leg Bend
exercises.cue: Wide stance, hinge forward and let your head hang.

exercises.name: Wide Leg Side Bend
exercises.cue: Wide stance, reach one arm overhead and lean to the side.

exercises.name: Wide Leg Toe Touches
exercises.cue: Wide stance, reach toward each foot in turn.

exercises.name: Wide Leg Torso Circles
exercises.cue: Wide fold, circle your upper body slowly around.

exercises.name: Wrist Circles (Arms Out)
exercises.cue: Arms out in front, make fists and circle your wrists.

exercises.name: Wrist Extension
exercises.cue: On all fours, fingers back toward knees, lean back gently.

exercises.name: Wrist Extension I
exercises.cue: Arm forward palm up, pull your fingers down gently.

exercises.name: Wrist Extension II
exercises.cue: Arm forward palm out, pull your fingers back toward you.

exercises.name: Wrist Flexion
exercises.cue: On all fours, backs of hands down, lean gently.

exercises.name: Wrist Flexion I
exercises.cue: Arm forward, palm down, press the back of the hand toward you.

exercises.name: Zombie Walks
exercises.cue: Walk forward kicking straight legs up toward your hands.
